claycode.delta: Add stale-handle lifetime conformance to CC-WP-07/11. Keep physical resource-instance/lifetime identity separate from semantic/capability identity. No core syntax change yet.

frank.delta: Any frozen FRANK subsystem crossing file/process/socket/DB/HTTP/GPU host-resource boundaries must reacquire fresh live resource identity after close/restart and must not retain stale execution authority.
frank.authority: Research Entity finding about Frank; not Frank self-modification authority.

harness.delta: Add close/drop -> slot/index reuse -> stale-use, move/borrow/duplicate, async outstanding-borrow and crash/recovery resource cases to APP-08 and H1/H2 differential evidence.

claygraph.delta: Graph resource nodes/relations may describe provenance/topology but graph identity, activation or salience must never by itself act as a live runtime resource handle.

unifieddb.delta: Persist resource descriptors/provenance, not resurrected live handle authority. Recovery/reopen must mint or obtain a fresh runtime resource-instance/lifetime identity.

gwt.delta: Workspace availability/selection/re-entry cannot extend the lifetime of a dropped runtime resource or reactivate stale authority.

hyperposition.delta: Alternative branches may carry separate resource intents/refs, but selected execution must validate the exact current live resource instance; branch coexistence does not authorize alias reuse.

emergenz.delta: NO_CHANGE to emergence claims. Resource-lifetime safety is a runtime validity/control condition, not causal-emergence evidence.

clayresearch.delta: Safe-Effect Geometry gains a concrete stale-resource-handle failure family; include lifetime/alias closure in generated-code/FFI end-to-end containment tests.
